enchantments.tooltip: Charisma +7: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +7 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Insightful Wisdom +2: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Wisdom.
Healing Lore VI: Passive: Your Positive Energy spells gain a 16% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Amaunator's Blessing: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of all your spells.
